fixes.text: 5% of PR heads went green only on a rerun: track and fix flakes
Setup on the critical path: 2.4 min of setup in jobs that first wait on others; start it while they wait, and wait only for the step you need
A blocker most jobs wait on: "E2E: Build …" holds up 13 of 16 jobs, 90.1 job-min past their other needs; shorten it, or let them start setup and wait only for what they need

Split @automattic/jetpack-components#.: it re-exports 55 modules to at least 5 packages, so an edit to any of them reaches all of those packages' checks; give each area its own entry, listed by name, not `export *`
Packages depend on each other in a cycle, @automattic/i18n-check-webpack-plugin ↔ @automattic/jetpack-webpack-config: break it, so an edit to one stops reaching the rest
